card.name: Subject and verb after 'as' comparisons
card.fires_on: Pronouns and verbs right after 'as' or 'not as' when a clause describing how things are, were or will be follows, such as 'as they are' or 'as it will exist'.

modes.label: Pronoun after as
modes.description: A pronoun starting the clause after 'as', in a contrast between how things are and how they are imagined.
modes.example: knowledge of things as<< they>> are, and as they were, and

modes.label: Verb in the as-clause
modes.description: The verb or auxiliary that follows the pronoun in an 'as X is/will' clause.
modes.example: not as it<< will>> exist sometime in the future

modes.label: Want or like in as-clause
modes.description: A verb of wanting or liking inside a comparison clause.
modes.example: be the adult you<< want>> your children to be

card.plain: It marks the spot inside phrases like 'as they are' or 'as it will be', where the text compares how things really are with how they might be.
